hero.title: Designing for the Agentic Era.
body: I lead design systems and UX across regulated platforms, civic services, and AI products. I own migrations, governance partnerships, and the delivery discipline that keeps systems working at scale. I stay close to the work, close to the code, and close to the people using it.

resume.label: Background and experience.
resume.headline: How I learned there is no one solution.
intro: My path has run through very different clients, teams, and stacks. None of them worked the same way, and I've stopped believing there's one approach that fits everything. What I appreciate most is learning each time — new tools, new constraints, custom solutions — and building in a way that makes teams stronger, not dependent on me.

projects.name: Brasserie Colette
projects.description: Directed the end-to-end redesign and headless rebuild for Tim Raue's Brasserie Colette, shaping UX and Nuxt/Prismic architecture to support multi-city menus and reservations.

projects.name: Open Wonder
projects.description: Shaping how AI systems balance creative freedom with brand restrictions. Daily involvement in LLM process definition, governance at scale, and AI-assisted development with Cursor agents. Product design and development on both sides simultaneously.

projects.name: Dein WoMo

projects.name: DPF Group
projects.description: Central point of contact for everything digital across 6 premium brands — each with distinct design systems and stacks. Led CRM migration to Microsoft Dynamics, coordinated brand, marketing, SEO, HR, and Google Ads teams while keeping it all maintainable.

projects.name: easyCredit Partner
projects.description: Owned design and development management for the B2B payment services portal — registration flows, banner configurator, developer docs, and shop plugins. Partnered directly with Head of Product to align product, partner experience, and developer experience.

projects.name: Electronica Group

Multilingual assistant (15+ languages), privacy-compliant (PwC audited), with 'think first' principle: no hallucinations, routine automated, edge cases to humans.

projects.name: TeamBank

work.name: Open Wonder
work.summary: I work across product discovery, model evaluation, workflow design, and production quality for an AI brand-asset platform. My role covers how brand and art-direction requirements are translated into generation logic, how output quality is evaluated, and how generation workflows are integrated into the tools creative teams already use.
highlights: Defined evaluation, feedback, and versioning structures so generated outputs can be reviewed, improved, and governed at production standard.
Led integration of generation workflows into Figma and CMS environments, including plugin development, API scope design, and support for banner-campaign production.
Build observability pipelines (Sentry → Slack → Linear → GitHub Actions) that close the loop from user feedback to shipped fix
Design prompt-enhancer workflows with memory persistence for iterative AI generation on Gemini 2.0/2.1

work.name: AN®
work.summary: I own delivery across a portfolio of clients with different stacks, stakeholders, and definitions of done. My role is to align design quality, accessibility, and technical standards with how each client operates, and to make design systems and design operations useful and sustainable rather than a burden.
highlights: Established quality as a delivery discipline across the portfolio — CI/CD, automated testing, Sentry, Playwright, and release traceability.
Accessibility audits, plugin development, and bringing UX standards to client leadership, internal stakeholders, and engineers who think in different terms.
Scale design operations across regulated and B2B platforms — rituals, tooling, and reviews without the process theater
Traceability, git discipline, and release documentation so everyone can trust what shipped and why

work.name: Unit U+2463 GmbH
work.summary: I led UX across a multi-brand portfolio with different technical and organizational constraints. My role combined research, prototyping, and system design to establish foundations that stayed reliable through relaunches, team changes, and new use cases.
highlights: Established design-system foundations in Figma and token-based workflows to support consistent implementation across teams.
Built trust with product and marketing stakeholders by translating UX decisions into KPI-relevant outcomes and clearer delivery priorities.
Defined UX standards and ensured design-production parity across three CMS stacks

work.name: Ape Unit GmbH
work.summary: I owned the end-to-end design process for responsive web apps and campaign sites: research, information architecture, visual design, and prototypes. I worked closely with developers on handoff and production quality, and on keeping style guides and component patterns usable as platforms and use cases changed.
highlights: Photoshop, Sketch, Zeplin, InVision — the full path from wireframe to developer handoff.
Style guides and component patterns that evolved with each platform and use case, with alignment between the teams building them and the teams executing them.
Ran moderated usability tests and analytics reviews to improve clarity and task success
Maintained brand consistency and accessibility standards across launches

work.name: Ape Unit GmbH
work.summary: 3-month internship supporting web campaigns and early UX research, contributing UI assets, prototypes, and QA feedback.
highlights: Created UI comps and icon sets for responsive campaigns in Photoshop/Illustrator
Contributed to a Natural User Interface study supporting a bachelor's thesis research track
Built interactive prototypes in HTML/CSS, assisted QA, and documented feedback for senior designers

work.summary: Freelance brand and graphic designer delivering identity systems and multi-channel collateral for local businesses, owning client discovery, scope, and production delivery.
highlights: Delivered logo and brand identity packages for 10+ local small businesses across Berlin
Produced print collateral (business cards, flyers, menus) with press-ready specs and vendor coordination
Scoped and budgeted projects end-to-end, managing client communication from kickoff through production

successes.title: Go Where the Complexity Is

successes.title: Make Design Systems Fun Again

successes.title: Enable, Don't Just Execute
successes.summary: I don't just build — I make teams capable of building themselves. Enablement over handoff.

successes.title: Think in Systems, Ship in Iterations
successes.summary: I prototype, test, iterate. Big-bang launches are risky; small bets compound into real impact.
